statements.statement: The patient has a history of palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying arrhythmia
The patient has unspecified atrial fibrillation
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
Prolonged monitoring is required to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained or submitted prior to the service date
